payload.content: Travel Content Factory: root .env is the single source of truth. start.sh does `cp .env backend/.env` on every run, overwriting backend/.env. Always edit ROOT .env, never backend/.env directly. Keys: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ABACUS_AI_API_KEY.
